functions.name: cl_debug
functions.description: Enable libclamav debug messages globally. Call before going multithreaded if you want debug from early initialization.
requirements: Should be called before spawning threads to ensure consistent logging behavior.

functions.name: cl_always_gen_section_hash
functions.description: Instruct libclamav to always create section hashes for PE files (used by .mdb signatures).
requirements: Call before scans to affect hashing behavior for PE files.

functions.name: cl_initialize_crypto
functions.description: Initialize the OpenSSL crypto system. Called by cl_init(); cleanup is handled automatically by OpenSSL 1.0.2h/1.1.0+. Always returns 0.
requirements: May be called prior to scanning; typically cl_init() suffices.

functions.name: cl_cleanup_crypto
functions.description: Deprecated. Previously cleaned up OpenSSL initialization; now a no-op since OpenSSL auto-deinit handles cleanup.
requirements: Do not rely on this for cleanup; kept for compatibility.

functions.name: cl_init
functions.description: Initialize the ClamAV library. Sets up global state; returns CL_SUCCESS on success.
requirements: Must be called before creating/using an engine.
initoptions parameter currently unused.

functions.name: cl_engine_new
functions.description: Allocate and return a new scanning engine with default settings. Free with cl_engine_free().
requirements: Caller must free with cl_engine_free() when done.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_num
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_engine_set_num(struct cl_engine *engine, enum cl_engine_field field, long long num);
functions.description: Set a numerical engine option identified by field to value num.
requirements: engine must be a valid initialized engine.
Only use fields documented as numeric in enum cl_engine_field.
Not thread-safe to change options on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_get_num
functions.signature: long long cl_engine_get_num(const struct cl_engine *engine, enum cl_engine_field field, int *err);
functions.description: Get a numerical engine option value for field. Optionally returns a status via err.
requirements: engine must be a valid initialized engine.
err may be NULL if status not needed.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_str
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_engine_set_str(struct cl_engine *engine, enum cl_engine_field field, const char *str);
functions.description: Set a string engine option identified by field to str. Replaces previously set string.
requirements: engine must be a valid initialized engine.
str must be a valid NUL-terminated string.
Not thread-safe to change options on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_get_str
functions.signature: const char *cl_engine_get_str(const struct cl_engine *engine, enum cl_engine_field field, int *err);
functions.description: Get the string value for a string engine option. Optionally returns a status via err.
requirements: engine must be a valid initialized engine.
Returned pointer is owned by engine; do not free.
err may be NULL if status not needed.

functions.name: cl_engine_settings_copy
functions.description: Copy settings from an existing engine into a newly allocated settings struct.
requirements: engine must be configured/initialized.
Returned cl_settings must be freed with cl_engine_settings_free().

functions.name: cl_engine_settings_apply
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_engine_settings_apply(struct cl_engine *engine, const struct cl_settings *settings);
functions.description: Apply a cl_settings to an engine.
requirements: engine must be a valid engine.
settings must be a valid settings object produced by cl_engine_settings_copy().
Not thread-safe to change options on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_settings_free
functions.description: Free a cl_settings object previously returned by cl_engine_settings_copy().
requirements: settings must be a pointer previously obtained from cl_engine_settings_copy().

functions.name: cl_engine_compile
functions.description: Prepare/compile the engine after databases are loaded and settings applied.
requirements: engine must have databases loaded and desired settings applied.
Not thread-safe to change/compile an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_addref
functions.description: Increment the engine's reference count to prevent premature free in multithreaded usage.
requirements: engine must be a valid engine. Initially refcount=1; call when sharing across additional threads.

functions.name: cl_engine_free
functions.description: Decrement the engine reference count and free when it reaches zero.
requirements: engine must be a valid engine pointer or NULL (CL_ENULLARG if NULL per docs where applicable).
Only call as many times as references were acquired (initial + addref calls).

functions.name: cl_fmap_open_handle
functions.signature: cl_fmap_t *cl_fmap_open_handle(void *handle, size_t offset, size_t len, clcb_pread pread_cb, int use_aging);
functions.description: Create a file map over data accessible via a pread-like callback using a caller-supplied handle. Enables scanning of custom sources.
requirements: handle and pread_cb must be valid; pread_cb must implement reading count bytes at given offset into buf and return bytes read, 0 on EOF, or -1 with errno.
offset is initial scan start; len is total content length for the entire file represented; must represent the whole file for correct detection.
use_aging non-zero enables aging cache behavior.

functions.name: cl_fmap_open_memory
functions.description: Create a file map over an in-memory buffer representing an entire file.
requirements: start must point to a buffer of length len containing the entire file contents, not a fragment.

functions.name: cl_fmap_set_name
functions.description: Set a UTF-8 name for the map (used for logging/debugging).
requirements: map must be a valid map.
name must be a NUL-terminated UTF-8 string.

functions.name: cl_fmap_get_name
functions.description: Get the UTF-8 name associated with a map, if set.
requirements: map and name_out must be non-NULL.
Returned pointer is a borrowed reference; do not free.

functions.name: cl_fmap_set_path
functions.description: Set the UTF-8 filesystem path for the map (used for logging/debugging).
requirements: map must be valid.
path must be a NUL-terminated UTF-8 string.

functions.name: cl_fmap_get_path
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_fmap_get_path(cl_fmap_t *map, const char **path_out, size_t *offset_out, size_t *len_out);
functions.description: Get the filesystem path and optionally the current layer's file offset and length. May be NULL if path is unknown.
requirements: map and path_out must be non-NULL.
offset_out and len_out may be NULL if not needed.
Do not free returned path pointer.
Will return CL_EACCES if the map does not have a file descriptor; may return CL_ENULLARG for null args.

functions.name: cl_fmap_get_fd
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_fmap_get_fd(const cl_fmap_t *map, int *fd_out, size_t *offset_out, size_t *len_out);
functions.description: Get the file descriptor associated with a map, if any, and optionally layer offset/length. Returns CL_EACCES if no fd is associated.
requirements: map and fd_out must be non-NULL.
offset_out and len_out may be NULL.
Do not close or dup the returned file descriptor.

functions.name: cl_fmap_get_size
functions.description: Get the size of the current layer represented by the map.
requirements: map and size_out must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cl_fmap_set_hash
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_fmap_set_hash(const cl_fmap_t *map, const char *hash_alg, char hash);
functions.description: Set a precomputed file hash for the map using the specified algorithm. Overwrites an existing stored hash of that type.
requirements: map must be valid.
hash_alg must name the algorithm (e.g., "md5", "sha1", "sha2-256").
Caller provides hash value; memory ownership semantics are not documented here (the hash parameter type is a single char per header; details unknown).

functions.name: cl_fmap_have_hash
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_fmap_have_hash(const cl_fmap_t *map, const char *hash_alg, bool *have_hash_out);
functions.description: Check if a file hash of a given algorithm has already been calculated/stored for the map.
requirements: map, hash_alg, and have_hash_out must be non-NULL.
hash_alg should be one of the recognized names (e.g., "md5", "sha1", "sha2-256").

functions.name: cl_fmap_will_need_hash_later
functions.description: Hint that a specific hash type will be needed later to optimize hashing passes.
requirements: map and hash_alg must be non-NULL.
hash_alg should be recognized (e.g., "md5", "sha1", "sha2-256").

functions.name: cl_fmap_get_hash
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_fmap_get_hash(const cl_fmap_t *map, const char *hash_alg, char **hash_out);
functions.description: Get or compute the file hash string for the map using the requested algorithm. Will compute if not already cached/stored. Caller must free the returned string.
requirements: map, hash_alg, and hash_out must be non-NULL.
hash_alg limited to algorithms supported by this API (e.g., "md5", "sha1", "sha2-256").
Caller must free *hash_out using free().

functions.name: cl_fmap_get_data
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_fmap_get_data(const cl_fmap_t *map, size_t offset, size_t len, const uint8_t **data_out, size_t *data_len_out);
functions.description: Access a read-only pointer to data in the map from offset for len bytes (or until EOF if len==0). Not malloc'd; copy if you need to retain.
requirements: map, data_out, and data_len_out must be non-NULL.
Offset must be within the file; returned data_len_out may be less than requested at EOF.
Returned buffer is read-only and may be invalidated when map is closed.

functions.name: cl_fmap_close
functions.description: Close and release resources associated with a file map.
requirements: Call after you are done with the map and any dependent handles.
Do not use the map after closing.

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_fmap
functions.description: Get the cl_fmap associated with a scan layer.
requirements: layer and fmap_out must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_parent_layer
functions.description: Get the parent scan layer (or NULL for root).
requirements: layer and parent_layer_out must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_type
functions.description: Get the current file type string for a scan layer. This may change later in the scan.
requirements: layer and type_out must be non-NULL.
Returned pointer is a static reference; do not free.

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_recursion_level
functions.description: Get the recursion depth of the scan layer.
requirements: layer and recursion_level_out must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_object_id
functions.description: Get the unique object ID for the scan layer.
requirements: layer and object_id_out must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_last_alert
functions.description: Get the last detected alert name on this layer, or NULL if none. Do not free the returned pointer.
requirements: layer and alert_name_out must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cl_scan_layer_get_attributes
functions.description: Get attribute flags for the layer (LAYER_ATTRIBUTES_*).
requirements: layer and attributes_out must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_scan_callback
functions.signature: void cl_engine_set_scan_callback(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_scan callback, cl_scan_callback_t location);
functions.description: Register a clcb_scan callback at a specified scan phase (PRE_HASH, PRE_SCAN, POST_SCAN, ALERT, FILE_TYPE).
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.
callback may be NULL to clear.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_pre_cache
functions.description: Deprecated: Register a pre-cache callback (superseded by CL_SCAN_CALLBACK_PRE_HASH).
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_file_inspection
functions.description: Deprecated/unstable: Register a file inspection callback (superseded by CL_SCAN_CALLBACK_PRE_SCAN).
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_pre_scan
functions.description: Deprecated: Register a pre-scan callback (affected by clean cache).
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_post_scan
functions.description: Register a post-scan callback (deprecated in favor of general scan callback POST_SCAN).
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_virus_found
functions.description: Deprecated: Register a virus-found callback (cannot suppress alerts). Prefer CL_SCAN_CALLBACK_ALERT.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_sigload
functions.signature: void cl_engine_set_clcb_sigload(struct cl_engine *engine, clcb_sigload callback, void *context);
functions.description: Register a signature-load callback to allow skipping specific signatures at database load time.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.
Implementor must preserve signature dependency chains to avoid load failure.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_sigload_progress
functions.description: Register a progress callback for database load progress updates.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.
Callback return value is currently ignored but should return CL_SUCCESS.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_engine_compile_progress
functions.description: Register a progress callback for engine compile steps (rough item counts).
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_engine_free_progress
functions.description: Register a progress callback for engine free operations (rough item counts).
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_set_clcb_msg
functions.description: Set a global logging message callback for libclamav messages (info/warn/error). Overrides stderr logging for selected severities.
requirements: Should be called before multithreading; may be called before cl_init() to capture early logs.
Only one callback is supported; setting again overwrites previous.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_hash
functions.description: Deprecated: Register a hash stats callback (use CL_SCAN_CALLBACK_ALERT plus fmap hash APIs instead).
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_meta
functions.description: Register an archive metadata callback to allow blocking based on container metadata. Used by --archive-verbose.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_file_props
functions.description: Register a callback to receive JSON-encoded file properties after a scan when metadata collection is enabled and libclamav built with JSON support.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.
Requires CL_SCAN_GENERAL_COLLECT_METADATA and JSON-enabled build.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_vba
functions.description: Register a callback to receive extracted VBA macro data.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_stats_set_cbdata
functions.description: Associate caller-defined statistics cbdata with the engine for use by stats callbacks.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
cbdata must remain valid until stats are submitted or flushed.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_add_sample
functions.description: Register a callback to add a detected sample's metadata to a statistics report.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_remove_sample
functions.description: Register a callback to remove a sample from the statistics report.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_decrement_count
functions.description: Register a callback to decrement a sample's hit count in the statistics report (may remove when count reaches 0).
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_submit
functions.description: Register a callback to submit the accumulated statistics report.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_flush
functions.description: Register a callback to flush/free the statistics report data.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_get_num
functions.description: Register a callback to get the number of samples in the statistics report.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_get_size
functions.description: Register a callback to get the memory size used by the statistics report.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_set_clcb_stats_get_hostid
functions.description: Register a callback to obtain the machine's unique host ID for statistics.
requirements: engine must be initialized.
Not thread-safe to change callbacks on an in-use engine.

functions.name: cl_engine_stats_enable
functions.description: Enable the built-in statistics reporting feature.
requirements: engine must be initialized.

functions.name: cl_scandesc
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_scandesc(int desc, const char *filename, const char **virname, unsigned long int *scanned, const struct cl_engine *engine, struct cl_scan_options *scanoptions);
functions.description: Deprecated: Scan an open file descriptor. Returns CL_SUCCESS, CL_VIRUS, or CL_E* error. Outputs matched signature name and approximate scanned byte-count (scaled by CL_COUNT_PRECISION).
requirements: desc must be a valid open file descriptor.
engine must be a compiled engine with databases loaded.
scanoptions must be initialized.
virname and scanned may be NULL if not needed; if non-NULL, they are output-only and not to be freed.
filename is optional/hint.

functions.name: cl_scandesc_callback
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_scandesc_callback(int desc, const char *filename, const char **virname, unsigned long int *scanned, const struct cl_engine *engine, struct cl_scan_options *scanoptions, void *context);
functions.description: Deprecated: Scan an open file descriptor with an application-provided context passed to callbacks. Outputs as cl_scandesc.

functions.name: cl_scandesc_ex
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_scandesc_ex(int desc, const char *filename, cl_verdict_t *verdict_out, const char **last_alert_out, uint64_t *scanned_out, const struct cl_engine *engine, struct cl_scan_options *scanoptions, void *context, const char *hash_hint, char **hash_out, const char *hash_alg, const char *file_type_hint, char **file_type_out);

requirements: Returned pointer is static; do not free.

functions.name: cl_cvdhead
functions.description: Read the CVD header from a CVD file and return an allocated cl_cvd struct. Free with cl_cvdfree().
requirements: file must be a readable CVD path.
Caller must free the result with cl_cvdfree().

functions.name: cl_cvdparse
functions.description: Parse a CVD header from a header buffer and return an allocated cl_cvd struct. Free with cl_cvdfree().
requirements: head must point to a valid CVD header buffer; buffer length validation must be handled by caller (per docs).
Caller must free the result with cl_cvdfree().

functions.name: cl_cvdverify
functions.description: Deprecated: Verify a CVD by loading/unloading. Use cl_cvdverify_ex() instead.
requirements: file must be a readable CVD path.

functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_cvdverify_ex(const char *file, const char *certs_directory, uint32_t dboptions);

functions.name: cl_cvdfree

functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_cvdunpack_ex(const char *file, const char *dir, const char *certs_directory, uint32_t dboptions);

certs_directory required to verify external signatures.
dboptions may include CL_DB_FIPS_LIMITS and/or CL_DB_UNSIGNED.

functions.name: cl_cvdgetage
functions.description: Get age (seconds) of youngest file in a DB directory, or of a single CVD/CLD file.

age_seconds must be non-NULL.

functions.name: cl_statinidir
functions.description: Initialize a cl_stat handle to watch a database directory for changes. Must be freed with cl_statfree().

functions.name: cl_statchkdir

functions.name: cl_statfree

functions.name: cl_retflevel

functions.name: cl_retver

requirements: Returned pointer is static; do not free.

functions.name: cl_strerror

requirements: Returned pointer is static; do not free.

functions.name: cl_hash_data_ex
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_hash_data_ex(const char *alg, const uint8_t *data, size_t data_len, uint8_t **hash, size_t *hash_len, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Generate a hash over a data buffer using the specified algorithm. Supports allocation on demand and optional FIPS-bypass flag.
requirements: alg must be a supported OpenSSL digest name (e.g., "md5", "sha1", "sha2-256", "sha2-384", "sha2-512").
data must point to a buffer of length data_len.
hash must be non-NULL; if CL_HASH_FLAG_ALLOCATE set, function allocates *hash and caller must free; else caller must provide buffer via *hash and set *hash_len to buffer size.
hash_len must be non-NULL; if allocating, it is output-only.
flags may include CL_HASH_FLAG_ALLOCATE and/or CL_HASH_FLAG_FIPS_BYPASS.

functions.name: cl_hash_init_ex
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_hash_init_ex(const char *alg, uint32_t flags, cl_hash_ctx_t **ctx_out);
functions.description: Initialize a hashing context for the specified algorithm with flags (e.g., FIPS bypass).
requirements: alg must be a supported digest name.
ctx_out must be non-NULL; receives an allocated context; destroy with cl_hash_destroy_ex().

functions.name: cl_update_hash_ex
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_update_hash_ex(cl_hash_ctx_t *ctx, const uint8_t *data, size_t length);
functions.description: Add data to an existing hash context.
requirements: ctx must be a context from cl_hash_init_ex().
data may be NULL only if length==0; otherwise must point to at least length bytes.

functions.name: cl_finish_hash_ex
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_finish_hash_ex(cl_hash_ctx_t *ctx, uint8_t **hash, size_t *hash_len, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Finalize the hash and get the digest. Optionally allocate the output buffer if CL_HASH_FLAG_ALLOCATE is set.
requirements: ctx must be a context from cl_hash_init_ex().
hash and hash_len must be non-NULL; if allocating, function allocates *hash and caller must free; else caller must provide buffer via *hash and set *hash_len to buffer size.
After finalization, destroy ctx with cl_hash_destroy_ex().

functions.name: cl_hash_destroy_ex
functions.description: Destroy a hash context created by cl_hash_init_ex().
requirements: ctx may be NULL; otherwise must be a valid context.

functions.name: cl_hash_file_fd_ex
functions.signature: cl_error_t cl_hash_file_fd_ex(const char *alg, int fd, size_t offset, size_t length, uint8_t **hash, size_t *hash_len, uint32_t flags);
functions.description: Generate a hash of file contents from a file descriptor, starting at offset for length bytes (or to EOF if length==0).
requirements: alg must be supported.
fd must be a valid open file descriptor readable at the given offset/length.
hash/hash_len usage and flags as in cl_hash_data_ex().

functions.description: Deprecated: Hash a data buffer (bypasses FIPS restrictions). Returns allocated buffer if obuf==NULL; otherwise uses caller-provided obuf.

functions.signature: unsigned char *cl_hash_file_fd_ctx(EVP_MD_CTX *ctx, int fd, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated: Hash a file via an OpenSSL EVP_MD_CTX and file descriptor. Returns malloc'd digest buffer.
requirements: ctx must be a valid OpenSSL EVP_MD_CTX prepared for hashing.
fd must be a valid readable descriptor.
Caller must free the returned buffer.
olen may be NULL; if non-NULL receives digest length.

functions.name: cl_hash_file_fd
functions.signature: unsigned char *cl_hash_file_fd(int fd, const char *alg, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated: Hash a file by fd (bypasses FIPS restrictions). Returns malloc'd digest buffer.

olen may be NULL; if non-NULL receives digest length.

functions.description: Deprecated: Hash a file by FILE* (bypasses FIPS restrictions). Returns malloc'd digest buffer.

alg must be supported by OpenSSL.
Caller must free the returned buffer.
olen may be NULL; if non-NULL receives digest length.

functions.name: cl_sha256
functions.signature: unsigned char *cl_sha256(const void *buf, size_t len, unsigned char *obuf, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated: Compute SHA-256 digest for a buffer. Prefer cl_hash_data_ex().
requirements: buf must point to len bytes.
If obuf is NULL, caller must free returned buffer; otherwise provide sufficiently large buffer (SHA256_HASH_SIZE).
olen may be NULL; if non-NULL receives digest length.

functions.name: cl_sha384
functions.signature: unsigned char *cl_sha384(const void *buf, size_t len, unsigned char *obuf, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated: Compute SHA-384 digest for a buffer. Prefer cl_hash_data_ex().
requirements: buf must point to len bytes.
If obuf is NULL, caller must free returned buffer; otherwise provide sufficiently large buffer (SHA384_HASH_SIZE).
olen may be NULL; if non-NULL receives digest length.

functions.name: cl_sha512
functions.signature: unsigned char *cl_sha512(const void *buf, size_t len, unsigned char *obuf, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated: Compute SHA-512 digest for a buffer. Prefer cl_hash_data_ex().
requirements: buf must point to len bytes.
If obuf is NULL, caller must free returned buffer; otherwise provide sufficiently large buffer (SHA512_HASH_SIZE).
olen may be NULL; if non-NULL receives digest length.

functions.name: cl_sha1
functions.signature: unsigned char *cl_sha1(const void *buf, size_t len, unsigned char *obuf, unsigned int *olen);
functions.description: Deprecated: Compute SHA-1 digest for a buffer (FIPS-bypassed). Prefer cl_hash_data_ex().
requirements: buf must point to len bytes.
If obuf is NULL, caller must free returned buffer; otherwise provide sufficiently large buffer (SHA1_HASH_SIZE).
olen may be NULL; if non-NULL receives digest length.

functions.name: cl_hash_init
functions.description: Deprecated: Initialize a hash context (FIPS-bypassed). Returns an opaque context pointer.
requirements: alg must be supported by OpenSSL.
Destroy with cl_hash_destroy().

functions.signature: int cl_update_hash(void *ctx, const void *data, size_t sz);
functions.description: Deprecated: Update a legacy hash context with data. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error.
requirements: ctx must be a context from cl_hash_init().
data may be NULL only if sz==0; else must point to at least sz bytes.

functions.name: cl_finish_hash
functions.description: Deprecated: Finalize a legacy hash context and write digest to caller-provided buffer. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error.
requirements: ctx must be from cl_hash_init().
buf must be large enough for the digest for the chosen algorithm.

functions.name: cl_hash_destroy
functions.description: Deprecated: Destroy a legacy hash context.
requirements: ctx may be NULL; otherwise must be a context from cl_hash_init().

functions.name: cl_verify_signature
functions.signature: int cl_verify_signature(EVP_PKEY *pkey, const char *alg, unsigned char *sig, unsigned int siglen, unsigned char *data, size_t datalen, int decode);
functions.description: Verify a signature over raw data using a public key and hash algorithm. Optionally base64-decodes the signature before verification. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error/invalid.
requirements: pkey must be a valid public key.
alg must be a supported hash algorithm name.
sig must point to siglen bytes; if decode==1, sig must be base64-encoded.

functions.name: cl_verify_signature_hash
functions.signature: int cl_verify_signature_hash(EVP_PKEY *pkey, const char *alg, unsigned char *sig, unsigned int siglen, unsigned char *digest);
functions.description: Verify a signature over a precomputed digest using a public key and algorithm. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error/invalid.
requirements: pkey must be valid.
alg must be supported.
sig must point to siglen bytes.
digest must point to the correct-length hash for alg.

functions.description: Verify a signature over file contents read from a file descriptor using the given public key and algorithm. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error/invalid.
requirements: pkey must be valid.
alg must be supported.
sig must point to siglen bytes.
fd must be a valid readable file descriptor.

functions.signature: int cl_verify_signature_hash_x509_keyfile(char *x509path, const char *alg, unsigned char *sig, unsigned int siglen, unsigned char *digest);
functions.description: Verify a signature over a digest using a public key loaded from an X509 PEM key file path. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error/invalid.
requirements: x509path must refer to a readable X509 key file.
alg must be supported.
sig/digest must be valid pointers; siglen correct.

functions.name: cl_verify_signature_fd_x509_keyfile

functions.description: Verify a signature over file contents using a public key loaded from an X509 key file path. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error/invalid.
requirements: x509path must refer to a readable X509 key file.
alg must be supported.
sig must be valid; fd must be readable.

functions.name: cl_verify_signature_x509_keyfile
functions.signature: int cl_verify_signature_x509_keyfile(char *x509path, const char *alg, unsigned char *sig, unsigned int siglen, unsigned char *data, size_t datalen, int decode);
functions.description: Verify a signature over raw data using a public key loaded from an X509 key file. Optionally base64-decodes signature. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error/invalid.
requirements: x509path must be a readable X509 key file.
alg must be supported.
sig/data pointers valid; sizes correct.

requirements: x509 must be valid; alg supported; sig valid; fd readable.

functions.signature: int cl_verify_signature_x509(X509 *x509, const char *alg, unsigned char *sig, unsigned int siglen, unsigned char *data, size_t datalen, int decode);
functions.description: Verify a signature over raw data using an X509 object. Optionally base64-decodes signature. Returns 0 on success, -1 on error/invalid.
requirements: x509 must be valid; alg supported; sig/data valid; sizes correct.
